hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const userPrompt=i.user_prompt||i.prompt||'';const hasChinese=/[\u4e00-\u9fa5]/.test(userPrompt);if(hasChinese){console.log('Language detected: Chinese');}else{console.log('Language detected: English');}}catch(e){console.log('Hook error:',e.message);}})"
hooks.description: Auto-detect language (Chinese/English) based on prompt content

UserPromptSubmit.description: Language detection hook for Chinese/English prompts
